_comment: One place for what testers read on each build: TestFlight's What to Test (tool/testflight.py) and Play's release notes (tool/play_upload.py). Change it with the version in pubspec.yaml; a build whose version is not this one says so in its notes instead of repeating an old release's.
what_to_test: Sign-up, account and store rules: 1. Register a new venue: the last step is Start free trial; the 14 days start at once and the app asks for no card or payment. 2. More > Delete my Vesopa account explains what it removes, then opens Vesopa's account deletion page. 3. On iPhone, Tap to Pay on iPhone is not offered until Apple switches it on for Vesopa Go: the card button goes to the card machine, with QR Pay beside it. Since 1.2.75 also: TVs and the phone remote, like Google TV's: 1. More > Screens and TVs > Control a screen: screens on the same Wi-Fi show Local, others Live; tap one. 2. Connected bar at the bottom of Go; several screens at once. 3. D-pad or swipe pad, Back, Home, mute and volume (the TV's own), power (screen off/on), keyboard (type into the TV's box). 4. On the screen: the TV's buttons and settings live on the phone; tap one to press it. 5. Microphone: say 'show the last order and mark it done', 'next advert', 'keep this advert for 5 minutes', 'volume up', 'switch to kitchen' (? lists them). 6. Kitchen: new orders fill the screen for 10 s with the chime (Settings or the phone); Open | Closed | Phone orders; Back goes up to the tabs. 7. Switching Kitchen/Customer display changes the TV at once. 8. TV: the first remote key always lands on something, a thick ring shows where; Back on the first screen asks to quit. 9. Every TV shows the same layout whatever its resolution. 10. More > About this screen: name, model, Android, pixels, id. 11. Back from the background: the Vesopa mark while Go refreshes.
release_notes: Start your free trial straight from the app with nothing to pay up front, delete your Vesopa account from More, and control your kitchen TV and customer display from your phone like a Google TV remote.
